diagnosis: Deterministic structural race in the Order-105 causal ack handshake strict first-exchange filter: the controller ack{state_seq=just-published-tick, command_seq} is written on the controller own command-write cadence and arrives over DDS after the simulator has already advanced published_state_seq_ to the next lockstep tick. OnAckReceived ignores only acks with command_seq <= barrier_seq_; an ack for the previous state whose command_seq exceeds the barrier command is classified as kViolationAckStale and fails closed. Reproduced independently on both members (baseline: ack{2300,3} during first exchange; terrain: ack{1924,5} during second exchange after a clean first exchange). Environment is exact-SHA and clean on both members. Unit tests script one-command-per-state acks without real DDS latency and therefore pass while the real system fails.
